trap.label: biografia (virada)
trap.wrong: She was born in Mexico. After an accident, she started to paint. Her house is museum now.
trap.right: She was born in Mexico. After an accident, she started painting. Her house is a museum now.
trap.why: Em português “virou museu” dispensa artigo (“é museu”). Em inglês o artigo é obrigatório com substantivo contável singular. Also start pode ser com to ou -ing.

fix.wrong: After the accident she start paint.
fix.right: After the accident she started painting.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Many people visit her house.”
rewrite.answer: Her house is visited by many people.
